Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect suspend a different card from the one that's given "can't unsuspend until the end of their turn"?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Tamers. Then, 1 of their Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: ＜Retaliation＞ (When only this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
